changelog:
Initial release of "diagram-to-code" skill.

- Converts architecture diagrams (Mermaid, PlantUML, draw.io, ASCII, or text-based) into infrastructure as code or component code.
- Includes strict activation triggers; only processes requests with clear diagrams.
- Returns code in appropriate formats (Terraform, Kubernetes YAML, CloudFormation, workflow scripts, component code) mapped from diagram elements.
- Handles validation, clear error messages, and states assumptions when input is ambiguous.
- Provides a mapping of diagram nodes to code resources in responses.
- Declines off-topic or invalid requests with concise explanations.
summary: Use when (1) user provides architecture diagram and needs infrastructure as code or component code.
